visualStyle.promptTemplate: Vintage 1930s-1950s comic book and medical illustration style. Characters are expressive with exaggerated features. The color palette is muted, dominated by sepia, brown, and aged paper tones. Strong line work and cross-hatching for shading. The overall feel is nostalgic, like an old educational film or a classic cartoon. Dominant palette: #DDCDBA, #5C3D2E, #A98A70, #3D2B1F, #E4D5B7, #8B0000. Aesthetic: vintage comic style, medical illustration, storytelling ad, sepia tone, character animation, pain-agitation-solution. Vertical 9:16 composition, single coherent scene, no watermark, no embedded text (text overlays are added in post-production).
